# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `make gen` from the Go types in internal/config. Do not edit. -->

Every key the configuration file accepts, in the order the loader defines them. Keys marked *required* have no default. Unknown keys are rejected. The machine-readable form is [config.schema.json](config.schema.json). How policy blocks inherit (global, site, endpoint) is described in [the configuration model](../architecture/config-model.md).

## Root

Root is the whole configuration document.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | integer | *Required.* Version of this document format; must be 1, the only version this build accepts (default 1 when omitted). |
| `global` | [Global](#global) | Settings shared by every site: admin listener, trusted proxies, certificate authority, events, default policy, IP lists and feeds. |
| `sites` | list of [Site](#site) | *Required.* The protected sites; at least one is required. |

## Global

Global holds settings shared by every site.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `admin` | [Admin](#admin) | The admin listener that serves /metrics, /healthz and /readyz. |
| `trusted_proxies` | list of string | Addresses or CIDR ranges of reverse proxies and load balancers in front of Sherlock whose client-address headers are trusted; empty means the client is the TCP peer and forwarded headers are ignored. |
| `client_ip_headers` | list of string | Headers read, in order, for the real client address when the request comes from a trusted proxy (default X-Forwarded-For when trusted_proxies is set). |
| `acme` | [ACME](#acme) | Settings for automatic certificates (sites with tls.mode acme). |
| `events` | [Events](#events) | The event pipeline: node name, retention, access log, redaction and sinks. |
| `defaults` | [Policy](#policy) | A policy block applied to every site; sites and endpoints override it field by field. |
| `ip_lists` | list of [IPList](#iplist) | Named lists of addresses and CIDR ranges that acl allow_lists and deny_lists refer to (at most 1000 lists and 1,000,000 entries in total). |
| `feeds` | [Feeds](#feeds) | Background data the node downloads and refreshes: country database, reputation lists and CrowdSec. |

## Admin

Admin configures the node's admin listener, which serves /metrics, /healthz and /readyz. It is separate from proxied traffic.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listen` | string | Address of the admin listener as host:port, or "off" to disable it (default 127.0.0.1:9444). |
| `allowed_cidrs` | list of string | Client addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to reach the admin listener; empty allows any client that can connect. |

## ACME

ACME configures automatic certificate issuance.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | Contact address sent to the certificate authority when ordering certificates; must contain an @. Optional. |
| `ca` | string | HTTPS URL of an ACME directory to use instead of Caddy's default certificate authorities (for example a private or staging CA). |

## Events

Events configures the event pipeline.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node_name` | string | Name stamped on every event so exports can tell nodes apart (default: the host name; at most 128 characters). |
| `retention_days` | integer | RetentionDays is how long stored events are kept (control-plane database only). |
| `access_log` | [AccessLog](#accesslog) | The optional sampled log of clean requests, off by default. |
| `body_excerpt` | boolean | Records a redacted excerpt of the request body in events (default false). |
| `redaction` | [Redaction](#redaction) | Extra redaction rules applied to events on top of the built-in ones. |
| `sinks` | [Sinks](#sinks) | Where events are written on the node itself. |

## AccessLog

AccessLog is the optional sampled log of clean requests (FR-EVT-3).

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the sampled access log on (default false). |
| `sample_rate` | number | Fraction of clean requests logged, from 0 to 1 (default 0.01). |

## Redaction

Redaction adds operator patterns to the built-in ones.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `patterns` | list of string | Patterns match parameter names (case-sensitive RE2; use (?i) for case-insensitive). |

## Sinks

Sinks selects the temporary event outputs used until the store exists.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stdout` | boolean | Writes security events as JSON lines to standard output (default true). |
| `file` | boolean | Writes security events to events.jsonl (and the access log to access.jsonl) in the data directory, with rotation (default true). |
| `file_max_mb` | integer | Size in MiB at which an event file is rotated, 1 to 10240 (default 100). |
| `file_keep` | integer | Number of rotated event files kept, 1 to 100 (default 5). |

## Policy

Policy is the protection block used at global, site and endpoint level (ADR-0012). Every field is optional; unset fields inherit.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of `off`, `detect`, `block` | off turns inspection off, detect records what would be blocked without blocking, block enforces (default detect). |
| `fail_mode` | one of `open`, `closed` | What happens to a request when a protection module fails internally: open lets it through, closed refuses it (default closed in block mode, otherwise open). |
| `waf` | [WAFPolicy](#wafpolicy) | Coraza and OWASP CRS tuning. |
| `block_page` | [BlockPage](#blockpage) | The page shown for requests Sherlock terminates. |
| `acl` | [ACLPolicy](#aclpolicy) | Access control: allow and deny lists, countries, reputation and the password gate. |
| `rate_limits` | list of [RateLimit](#ratelimit) | RateLimits are named items: levels are unioned by name, and a lower level may replace an item that has the same name. |
| `auto_ban` | [AutoBan](#autoban) | Bans a client address that keeps getting blocked. There is no built-in default: set blocks_threshold, window and ban_duration together. |
| `bot` | [BotPolicy](#botpolicy) | Bot defence: challenge pages for suspicious clients. |
| `api` | [APIPolicy](#apipolicy) | API protection: OpenAPI conformance, JWT validation and mutual TLS. |
| `login_protection` | [LoginPolicy](#loginpolicy) | Login protection: failed-login velocity per client address, username and device on declared login endpoints. |
| `dlp` | [DLPPolicy](#dlppolicy) | Data protection: scans responses for card numbers, IBANs and custom patterns and masks or blocks them. |
| `stacks` | name list | Stacks declares the technologies behind the site (wordpress, php, spring, ...). Product-specific virtual patches activate only for declared stacks. Unset means "auto": generic patches only. |
| `virtual_patches` | [VirtualPatchPolicy](#virtualpatchpolicy) | VirtualPatches switches the CVE rule pack (ADR-0013) per level. |
| `opt_out` | list of string | OptOut removes inherited named items, written "rate_limits:<name>", "exclusions:<id>" or "virtual_patches:<id>". It is the only way to drop a global item (and is audited with the change). |

## WAFPolicy

WAFPolicy tunes Coraza and CRS.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the WAF on or off for this level (default true). |
| `paranoia_level` | integer | CRS paranoia level, 1 to 4: higher levels enable more rules and produce more false positives (default 1). |
| `blocking_paranoia_level` | integer | Paranoia level at or below which rules count towards blocking, 1 to 4; it must not exceed paranoia_level (default: the paranoia_level). |
| `inbound_threshold` | integer | Anomaly score at which a request is blocked; at least 1 (default 5). |
| `outbound_threshold` | integer | Anomaly score at which a response is blocked when outbound inspection is on; at least 1 (default 4). |
| `outbound_inspection` | boolean | Also inspects response bodies for data leaks and error pages (default false). |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | Largest request body in bytes that is inspected, 1 to 1073741824 (1 GiB); default 10485760 (10 MiB). |
| `skip_inspection_extensions` | list of string | File extensions such as ".css" whose GET and HEAD requests skip body inspection (default: common static assets: css, js, images, icons and fonts). |
| `outbound_max_body_bytes` | integer | OutboundMaxBodyBytes bounds the response body kept for inspection when outbound_inspection is on; larger responses are inspected up to the limit. |
| `outbound_content_types` | list of string | OutboundContentTypes are the media types whose responses are inspected (prefix match on the type, e.g. "text/" or "application/json"). |
| `exclusions` | list of [Exclusion](#exclusion) | Exclusions are named, scoped rule removals (false-positive tuning). Levels are unioned by id; a lower level replaces an item with the same id. |
| `custom_rules` | string | CustomRules is operator SecLang (ids 10000-99999) loaded before CRS. The lowest level that sets it wins; it is validated by customrules. |

## Exclusion

Exclusion removes CRS rules, tags or rule targets for requests that match Match. It compiles to a runtime exclusion rule placed before CRS (T1).

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | *Required.* Lowercase slug that names the exclusion; unique within a level. |
| `description` | string | Why the exclusion exists, at most 500 characters. |
| `match` | [ExclusionMatch](#exclusionmatch) | Which requests the exclusion applies to; empty means all requests. |
| `remove_rule_ids` | list of string | CRS rule ids ("942100") or ranges ("942100-942199") that are not evaluated. Sherlock's own rules, virtual patches and custom rules cannot be removed here. |
| `remove_tags` | list of string | CRS rule tags whose rules are not evaluated. |
| `remove_targets` | list of [ExclusionTarget](#exclusiontarget) | Request targets removed from the checks of specific rules or tags. |

## ExclusionMatch

ExclusionMatch scopes an exclusion. Empty Paths means every path, empty Methods every method. Paths use path.Match globs ("*" does not cross "/"); a trailing "/**" matches the prefix and everything below it.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | list of string | Path globs the exclusion applies to; empty means every path. |
| `methods` | list of string | Upper-case HTTP methods the exclusion applies to; empty means every method. |

## ExclusionTarget

ExclusionTarget removes one request target (ARGS:q, REQUEST_COOKIES:/^_ga/) from the checks of the listed rules or tags.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rule_ids` | list of string | Rule ids or ranges the target is removed from (give rule_ids or tags). |
| `tags` | list of string | Rule tags the target is removed from (give rule_ids or tags). |
| `target` | string | *Required.* The request target to exclude, in CRS syntax such as ARGS:q, ARGS_NAMES:q or REQUEST_COOKIES:/^_ga/. |

## BlockPage

BlockPage selects the page shown for terminated requests.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | string | "default" or the id of an uploaded block page (default "default"). |

## ACLPolicy

ACLPolicy is the access-control block of a policy.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_lists` | name list | Names of ip_lists whose clients are allowed: they skip rate limits and bot checks. A list of names replaces the inherited list; {add, remove} edits it. |
| `deny_lists` | name list | Names of ip_lists whose clients are blocked. A list of names replaces the inherited list; {add, remove} edits it. |
| `countries` | [Countries](#countries) | Allows or denies clients by country, using the GeoIP database from feeds.geoip. |
| `reputation` | [ReputationACL](#reputationacl) | Acts on clients listed by the reputation feeds. |
| `password_gate` | [PasswordGate](#passwordgate) | PasswordGate puts HTTP Basic authentication in front of the site. |
| `allow_bypass_waf` | boolean | AllowBypassWAF lets allow-listed clients skip WAF inspection. Off by default: an allow list skips rate limits and bot checks, not the WAF. |

## Countries

Countries allows or denies ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | string | off, allow (only the listed countries) or deny (all but the listed countries); default off. |
| `list` | list of string | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in capitals, without duplicates; an empty list with mode allow is rejected because it would block every country. |

## ReputationACL

ReputationACL acts on feed-listed addresses.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns reputation checks on (on by default whenever the reputation block is present). |
| `action` | string | block \| log |

## PasswordGate

PasswordGate configures the site password gate. PasswordHash is an argon2id PHC string (create one with `sherlock hash-password`); the clear password is never stored.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the gate on (on by default whenever the block is present); needs username and password_hash. |
| `username` | string | The accepted user name, at most 64 characters, without ':' or line breaks. |
| `password_hash` | string | argon2id hash of the password, starting with $argon2id$; never returned by the API. |

## RateLimit

RateLimit is one named limit.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | *Required.* Lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_' (at most 63); a lower level replaces an inherited limit of the same name. |
| `match` | [RateLimitMatch](#ratelimitmatch) | Restricts the limit to matching requests; empty applies it to every request. |
| `key` | string | ip \| header:<name> |
| `limit` | integer | *Required.* Requests allowed per window and key, 1 to 1,000,000. |
| `window` | duration | *Required.* Length of the counting window, 1s to 24h. |
| `action` | string | block \| challenge \| log |

## RateLimitMatch

RateLimitMatch narrows a limit to paths (path.Match globs) and methods.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | list of string | Path globs starting with '/' (at most 50); default ["/*"]. |
| `methods` | list of string | Upper-case HTTP methods; empty means every method. |

## AutoBan

AutoBan bans a client that keeps getting blocked.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns auto-ban on (on by default whenever the block is present). |
| `blocks_threshold` | integer | Number of blocked requests within window that triggers a ban, 1 to 1,000,000. |
| `window` | duration | Period in which blocks are counted, 1s to 24h. |
| `ban_duration` | duration | How long the client stays banned, 1m to 30d. |

## BotPolicy

BotPolicy configures the bot module: challenge pages for suspicious clients. Every field is optional and inherits like the rest of a policy.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns bot defence on (on by default whenever the block is present). |
| `challenge` | string | Challenge is pow (self-hosted proof of work), turnstile or hcaptcha. The provider secrets come from the environment (SHERLOCK_TURNSTILE_SECRET, SHERLOCK_HCAPTCHA_SECRET), never from the configuration. |
| `difficulty` | integer | Difficulty is the number of leading zero hex digits the proof of work needs (4 takes a browser well under a second). |
| `clearance_ttl` | duration | ClearanceTTL is how long a passed challenge is remembered. |
| `site_key` | string | SiteKey is the public key of a turnstile or hcaptcha widget. |
| `verified_bots` | string | VerifiedBots says what to do with clients that claim to be a search engine and whose address checks out by reverse DNS: allow (default), challenge or block. Claims that do not verify are treated as ordinary clients. |
| `rules` | list of [BotRule](#botrule) | Rules evaluated in order against each request; at most 50. A lower level replaces the whole list. |

## BotRule

BotRule challenges (or blocks, or lets through) requests that match.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `match` | [BotMatch](#botmatch) | Which requests the rule applies to; every set field must match. |
| `action` | string | challenge (default) \| block \| allow |

## BotMatch

BotMatch selects requests; every set field must match.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | list of string | Path globs starting with '/'. |
| `methods` | list of string | Upper-case HTTP methods. |
| `countries` | list of string | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in capitals. |
| `reputation` | boolean | Reputation true matches clients on a reputation list. |

## APIPolicy

APIPolicy configures the API module: OpenAPI conformance, JWT validation and mutual TLS. Every field is optional and inherits like the rest of a policy.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns API protection on (on by default whenever the block is present). |
| `openapi_doc_id` | string | OpenAPIDocID refers to an uploaded OpenAPI document (3.0 or 3.1). |
| `unknown_path_action` | string | UnknownPathAction applies to requests the document does not describe (path or method): log (default) or block. Blocking needs openapi_doc_id. |
| `schema_violation_action` | string | SchemaViolationAction applies to documented requests whose parameters or body break the schema: log (default) or block. Blocking needs openapi_doc_id. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | MaxBodyBytes bounds the request body read for schema validation; larger bodies are not validated (the finding says so). |
| `jwt` | list of [JWTRule](#jwtrule) | JWT rules are a list: a lower level replaces the whole list. |
| `mtls` | [MTLSPolicy](#mtlspolicy) | Requires a verified client certificate on the listed paths. |

## JWTRule

JWTRule validates bearer tokens on the requests it matches. Keys come from exactly one of JWKSURL (fetched by a background job, never on the request path), PublicKeyPEM or HMACSecretEnv.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `match` | [APIMatch](#apimatch) | Which requests the rule applies to (default all paths and methods). |
| `jwks_url` | string | JWKSURL must be https and may not point at a private, loopback or link-local address (SSRF, threat T13). |
| `public_key_pem` | string | PublicKeyPEM is a static RSA, ECDSA or Ed25519 public key. |
| `hmac_secret_env` | string | HMACSecretEnv names the environment variable holding a shared secret. It is the only way to accept HS256/384/512 tokens. |
| `issuer` | string | Required value of the token's iss claim; set issuer or audiences (or both). |
| `audiences` | list of string | Accepted values of the token's aud claim, at most 20; the token must carry at least one. |
| `clock_skew` | duration | ClockSkew tolerates small clock differences in exp/nbf (default 30s). |
| `refresh_interval` | duration | RefreshInterval is how often the JWKS is refetched (default 15m). |
| `optional` | boolean | Optional lets requests without a token through; a token that is present must still be valid. |
| `action` | string | Action for a missing or invalid token: block (default) or log. |

## APIMatch

APIMatch selects requests by path glob and method.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | list of string | Path globs starting with '/' (default ["/*"]). |
| `methods` | list of string | Upper-case HTTP methods; empty means every method. |

## MTLSPolicy

MTLSPolicy requires a verified client certificate on the listed paths. The CA is an uploaded CA bundle; the site's TLS listener asks for a certificate (without insisting) and the API module enforces the paths.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `required_paths` | list of string | Path globs (at most 50) on which a verified client certificate is required. |
| `ca_cert_id` | string | Id of an uploaded CA bundle the client certificate must chain to; required when required_paths is set. |

## LoginPolicy

LoginPolicy configures the login-protection module (FR-FIN-1): failed-login velocity per client address, per username and per device, answered with a challenge or a block. Every field is optional and inherits like the rest of a policy; Endpoints is a list, so a lower level replaces it as a whole.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns login protection on (on by default whenever the block is present, but nothing is watched until an endpoint is declared). |
| `endpoints` | list of [LoginEndpoint](#loginendpoint) | Endpoints declares the login requests Sherlock watches. Nothing is watched until at least one is declared. |
| `thresholds` | [LoginThresholds](#loginthresholds) | Failures allowed per window before the action applies; unset values inherit. |
| `action` | string | Action is what happens to a client over a threshold: challenge (default), block or log. In detect mode it is recorded and never enforced. |

## LoginEndpoint

LoginEndpoint is one login request: a path glob and method, where the username is in the request, and which upstream statuses mean "failed".

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | Path glob starting with '/'. |
| `method` | string | default POST |
| `username_field` | string | UsernameField is a JSON pointer ("/user/email") for JSON bodies or a field name ("email") for form bodies. Usernames are only ever kept as a keyed hash. |
| `failure_statuses` | list of integer | FailureStatuses are the upstream statuses counted as a failed login (default 401 and 403). |

## LoginThresholds

LoginThresholds are the failures allowed per window before Action applies. A zero field inherits.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `per_ip` | integer | Failed logins per client address in the window, 1 to 100000 (default 20). |
| `per_username` | integer | Failed logins per username in the window, from any address, 1 to 100000 (default 5). |
| `per_device` | integer | Failed logins per device fingerprint in the window, 1 to 100000 (default 10). |
| `window` | duration | Period in which failures are counted, 1m to 24h (default 10m). |

## DLPPolicy

DLPPolicy configures the data-loss-prevention module (FR-FIN-2): it scans responses for card numbers, IBANs and custom patterns and masks or blocks them. Matched values are never written to events, logs or exports.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns data protection on (on by default whenever the block is present). |
| `detect` | list of string | Detect lists what to look for: pan, iban, or custom:<name> for an entry of CustomPatterns. A list: a lower level replaces it. |
| `custom_patterns` | list of [DLPPattern](#dlppattern) | Named custom detectors, at most 20; a lower level replaces the whole list. |
| `action` | string | Action is mask (default), block or log. In detect mode a match is only recorded; the response is never changed. |
| `content_types` | list of string | ContentTypes is the allow-list of response media types that are scanned. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | MaxBodyBytes bounds how much of a response is scanned; a larger response is passed through untouched and counted as skipped. |

## DLPPattern

DLPPattern is a named custom detector. The pattern is a Go (RE2) regular expression, so it cannot cause catastrophic backtracking.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Name used in detect as custom:<name>: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (at most 32). |
| `pattern` | string | RE2 regular expression, at most 512 characters, that must not match the empty string. |

## VirtualPatchPolicy

VirtualPatchPolicy enables the virtual-patch pack and lists patches to skip.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the virtual-patch pack on or off at this level (default true). |
| `disabled` | list of string | Disabled are patch ids (SV-2021-0001) switched off at this level; levels are unioned and a global entry is removed only through opt_out. |

## IPList

IPList is a named set of CIDRs referenced by ACL allow and deny lists.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | *Required.* Lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_' (at most 63); unique. |
| `cidrs` | list of string | *Required.* CIDR ranges or single addresses (IPv4 or IPv6). |

## Feeds

Feeds configures the background data the node refreshes. Secrets are never part of the document: the MaxMind licence key and the CrowdSec API key come from the environment (SHERLOCK_MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY, SHERLOCK_CROWDSEC_API_KEY).

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `geoip` | [GeoIPFeed](#geoipfeed) | The country database used by country ACLs and rules. |
| `reputation_lists` | list of string | Public reputation lists to download: firehol_level1, spamhaus_drop. |
| `crowdsec` | [CrowdSecConfig](#crowdsecconfig) | Connection to a CrowdSec local API. |

## GeoIPFeed

GeoIPFeed selects the country database.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | string | dbip-lite (default) \| maxmind |
| `auto_update` | boolean | Downloads and refreshes the database automatically when it is missing or stale (default false: a database file placed in the data directory by hand is used as is). |

## CrowdSecConfig

CrowdSecConfig connects to a CrowdSec local API as a bouncer.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the CrowdSec bouncer on (default false). |
| `lapi_url` | string | http or https URL of the CrowdSec local API; required when enabled. The API key comes from SHERLOCK_CROWDSEC_API_KEY. |
| `allow_private` | boolean | AllowPrivate lets the API live on a loopback or private address, which is where a local CrowdSec agent usually listens. Link-local addresses (the cloud metadata service) stay refused. |

## Site

Site is one protected website or API.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | *Required.* Lowercase slug (a-z, 0-9, '-', at most 63 characters) that identifies the site; unique. |
| `name` | string | Display name shown in the dashboard. |
| `hosts` | list of string | *Required.* Host names the site answers for: lowercase DNS names, optionally with a leading "*." wildcard, or IP addresses; at least one. |
| `path_prefix` | string | Serves only requests under this path (starts with '/', no '..'), so several sites can share a host; the longest prefix wins. Empty means the whole host. |
| `tls` | [TLS](#tls) | Certificates and transport security. |
| `upstreams` | [Upstreams](#upstreams) | *Required.* The origin servers behind the site. |
| `headers` | [Headers](#headers) | Response headers Sherlock adds. |
| `policy` | [Policy](#policy) | The site's protection policy; overrides global.defaults. |
| `endpoints` | list of [Endpoint](#endpoint) | Per-path policy overrides, at most 500. |

## TLS

TLS configures a site's certificates and transport security. With mode "file" the certificate is either a pair of files on the node (CertFile and KeyFile) or an uploaded certificate (CertID); never both.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of `acme`, `file`, `none` | acme obtains certificates automatically, file uses certificates you supply, none serves plain HTTP only (default acme). |
| `cert_file` | string | Path on the node of the PEM certificate chain; with mode file, use cert_file and key_file together or cert_id. |
| `key_file` | string | Path on the node of the PEM private key; used with cert_file. |
| `cert_id` | string | Id of an uploaded certificate; with mode file, use this instead of cert_file and key_file. |
| `min_version` | string | Lowest TLS version accepted, "1.2" or "1.3" (default "1.2"). |
| `hsts` | [HSTS](#hsts) | Strict-Transport-Security header settings. |

## HSTS

HSTS configures Strict-Transport-Security.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Sends Strict-Transport-Security on TLS sites (default true; only sent while headers.security_headers is on). |
| `max_age` | integer | max-age in seconds (default 31536000, one year). |
| `include_subdomains` | boolean | Adds includeSubDomains (default false). |

## Upstreams

Upstreams describes the origin servers behind a site.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `targets` | list of string | *Required.* Origin servers as host:port; at least one. |
| `lb_policy` | one of `round_robin`, `least_conn`, `ip_hash` | How requests are spread over targets: round_robin, least_conn or ip_hash (default round_robin). |
| `health_check` | [HealthCheck](#healthcheck) | Active health probe of the targets; off unless a path is set. |
| `tls` | [UpstreamTLS](#upstreamtls) | TLS towards the origin. |
| `timeouts` | [Timeouts](#timeouts) | Timeouts for upstream connections. |
| `http_version` | string | HTTPVersion pins the protocol spoken to the origin: "" (Caddy's default), "1.1", "2", or "h2c" (cleartext HTTP/2, which gRPC origins need). |
| `websockets` | boolean | WebSockets allows connection upgrades through to the origin (default true). The WAF cannot inspect frames, so deny is the strict choice. |

## HealthCheck

HealthCheck is an active upstream health probe; it is off when Path is empty.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | Path requested on each target, starting with '/'; empty turns health checking off. |
| `interval` | duration | Time between probes (default 10s). |
| `timeout` | duration | Time a probe may take; positive and not longer than interval (default 2s). |

## UpstreamTLS

UpstreamTLS configures TLS towards the origin.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Connects to the origin over TLS (default false). |
| `insecure_skip_verify` | boolean | Skips verifying the origin's certificate (default false). Leaves the connection open to interception: use for testing only. |
| `client_cert_id` | string | Id of an uploaded certificate presented to the origin for mutual TLS; needs enabled. |

## Timeouts

Timeouts bound upstream connections.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dial` | duration | Time allowed to connect to the origin (default 5s). |
| `read` | duration | Time allowed to read the origin's response (default 60s). |
| `write` | duration | Time allowed to send the request to the origin (default 60s). |

## Headers

Headers controls response headers added by Sherlock.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `security_headers` | boolean | Adds X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and, on TLS sites, Strict-Transport-Security to responses (default true). |

## Endpoint

Endpoint overrides the site policy for requests matching Match.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | *Required.* Lowercase slug that names the endpoint; unique within the site. |
| `match` | [EndpointMatch](#endpointmatch) | *Required.* Which requests the endpoint applies to. |
| `policy` | [Policy](#policy) | Policy overrides for matching requests; unset fields inherit from the site. |

## EndpointMatch

EndpointMatch selects requests by exactly one of Path, PathPrefix or PathGlob (path.Match syntax), optionally narrowed to Methods.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | Exact request path, starting with '/'. |
| `path_prefix` | string | Path prefix, starting with '/'. |
| `path_glob` | string | Path glob in path.Match syntax, starting with '/'. |
| `methods` | list of string | Upper-case HTTP methods the endpoint applies to; empty means every method. |
